name: What should I prepare before starting my search for a waterfront home in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before starting my search for a waterfront home in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting your search, it's beneficial to determine your budget, desired property type (single-family, condo, townhouse), specific boating requirements (boat size, need for direct ocean access, fixed bridges), and preferred lifestyle amenities. You should also consider your financing options and get pre-approved for a mortgage if applicable. Gathering this information helps Kelby Contreras narrow down options efficiently and focus on neighborhoods like Aventura, Fort Lauderdale, or Palm Beach that best match your criteria.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your budget, desired property type, boating needs, and financing options before starting your waterfront home search.
